response.sql: WITH base_data AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt FROM base_data WHERE optvolrt IS NOT NULL), pair_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM base_data WHERE optvolrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref, tradekind), with_deviation AS (SELECT pa.transref, pa.tradekind, pa.avg_optvolrt, (pa.avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt) as deviation FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pa.tradekind IS NOT NULL AND oa.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL), type_avg_deviation AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation_per_type FROM with_deviation GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT wd.tradekind, wd.avg_optvolrt, wd.deviation, (wd.deviation - tad.avg_deviation_per_type) as excess FROM with_deviation wd JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON wd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE wd.deviation > tad.avg_deviation_per_type) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
